mapper.sql: refund_no, payment_no, order_no, user_id, amount, status, active_key, reason, operator, operator_id, channel_refund_no, applied_at, finished_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from refund where order_no = #{orderNo} and status in (10, 20) order by created_at desc, refund_no desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into refund (refund_no, payment_no, order_no, user_id, amount, status, active_key, reason, operator, operator_id, applied_at) values (#{refundNo}, #{paymentNo}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{activeKey}, #{reason}, #{operator}, #{operatorId}, #{appliedAt})
